stage: Exploratory capacity/transport diagnostic using previously inspected target families
question: Can query-specific source utility models recover useful action-selection headroom before further probe acquisition work?

data.features: The original eight deployable lexical features followed by384 frozen MiniLM query coordinates; no corpus or probe features added.
data.portable_export: Deduplicate query IDs/features/buckets across backends per family. Preserve train/calibration/test action scores, test action costs, archived router choices/model label, RRF-all per-query scores, and input hashes. No raw documents/query text or model download is needed to rerun.

folds.outer: Leave one corpus family out and use only the two same-backend source families. Backend identity is documented side information.
folds.fit: Source train only; never refit on calibration or target outcomes.
folds.select: Highest equal-source-family mean calibration nDCG@10, using source calibration queries only.
folds.calibration_limitation: Calibration queries are new queries within the source corpora. This does not validate transfer to a new corpus family, and repeated research use makes all three target families development data.
folds.freeze_selection: Persist the source-selected model names before loading/scoring that fold's test outcomes. The candidate grid and source-only selection rule are frozen before the run.

candidate_grid.global_mean: Equal mean of the two source-family mean action utility vectors; the same global prior is used for shrinkage.

ridge.scaler: StandardScaler fit on source train only

cosine_knn.features: L2-normalize only coordinates8:392; lexical features do not enter distance
neighborhoods: balanced: k/2 nearest queries from each source family and equal-family mean
pooled: k nearest queries across both source families
cosine_knn.neighbor_weighting: Uniform selected-neighbor weights, not similarity weighting

candidate_grid.selection_ties: First in registered order: global mean, ridge10, ridge100, then k ascending, shrinkage ascending, balanced before pooled.
candidate_grid.target_grid_reporting: Report all15 target candidate outcomes for transparency but never select a model using those outcomes.

methods.primary: source_selected_query: source-calibration winner over all15 candidates
secondary: source_selected_knn: source-calibration winner among12 kNN candidates
baselines: RRF all five action result lists
methods.reconstruction_audit: Compare reconstructed choices and nDCG numerically with the archived semantic router. Report mismatches rather than assuming the algorithms are identical.
methods.fusion: Import the already-computed RRF-all vector from full_paper/natural/results/paired.json after exact query-ID matching; no new fusion selection is performed here.

costs.single_action_serving: Selected cached action's search/LLM/token charges; cache reuse does not imply free serving.
costs.feature_cost: Ridge/kNN require one query MiniLM encoding; fixed/original/HyDE/archive-fixed need no extra routing encoder. Report original batched feature-generation time per encoded query and separate measured predictor time. Batched encoder averages are not measured online latency.
costs.fusion: Sum search calls across actions, but charge the shared semantic/HyDE/decomposed format-generating call and tokens once. The three generation entries must match.
costs.not_cost_matched: RRF-all executes six searches and one shared generation per query under these caches. It is a stronger inference-time comparator, not a cost-matched single-action router.

evaluation.primary_metric: nDCG@10 per environment and equal-family/equal-backend macro
evaluation.intervals: 2000 paired-query bootstrap replicates per existing environment for primary vs fixed/archive/original/HyDE/RRF; seed20260910. Conditional descriptive intervals, no multiple-comparison or research-reuse correction, no population/new-family claim.
evaluation.no_macro_intervals: No independent-environment bootstrap that would ignore shared queries across backends.

freeze.enforcement: Hash verification before the registered model fitting/evaluation; changed code/evidence requires a new version.
